2026 Boston Arts Festival (Saturday)
events.description: Boston's only fine arts and live music festival devoted exclusively to Boston-area talent, held in the historic waterfront setting of Christopher Columbus Park. Family friendly and always free, with juried artists showing and selling work alongside a full day of local musicians. Rain or shine.

events.title: 2026 Boston Arts Festival (Sunday)
events.description: Day two of the Boston Arts Festival at Christopher Columbus Park on the waterfront: juried Boston-area artists showing and selling their work, plus live music from local musicians all day. Family friendly and always free, rain or shine.
